title: Theatre Arts
sourceText:

Degrees and Certificates

Theatre Arts

Theatre Arts

Studying the theatre arts of drama and dance expands and enriches learning, life and culture. You’ll develop knowledge and skills that can benefit you in a variety of careers involving live performance, production tech, design, writing, management, leadership, and administration. Theatre Arts: Drama and Dance offers three tracks to get you major ready for transfer: Acting, General, and Design/Tech.

          Featured Faculty

          See Theatre Arts Faculty page

Jenna Spinei

Adjunct Faculty

Seattle-based choreographer, performer and dance movement therapist Jenna Spinei holds a Movement Science BS from the University of Michigan, a Dance Movement Psychotherapy MA from Goldsmiths, University of London and is a Franklin Method® Certified Educator. She has been on faculty at Broadway Dance Ireland, Jackson School of the Arts and Cornish College of the Arts.
